description.value: Small Quarry Garden is a public ornamental garden nestled within Queen Elizabeth Park on Little Mountain in Vancouver, occupying a former basalt quarry. It is part of one of the city's most celebrated urban parks and offers a quiet, scenic detour for touring cyclists ascending or descending the hill. The garden's setting in a reclaimed quarry gives it a distinctive character compared to the park's other formal gardens.
